build_convnext_backbone: build a ConvNeXt backbone model with a specified architecture like tiny, small, base, or large
create_convnextblock_layer: create a ConvNeXtBlock with depthwise convolution, layer norm, and pointwise convolutions for feature extraction
build_convnextv2_with_grn: build a ConvNeXt V2 backbone by enabling GRN and setting layer_scale_init_value to zero
freeze_convnext_stages: freeze the first N stages of a ConvNeXt backbone to prevent gradient updates during training
get_convnext_layer_depth: get the layer-wise depth of a parameter name for layer decay scheduling in ConvNeXt
